How to be calm and clear-minded?
</message>
output: I keep wondering if there’s a trick to quieting the noise in my head so I can actually think straight. It feels like every little thing—work, people, my own thoughts—just piles up and makes it harder to see what really matters. I guess I’m scared that if I don’t find some way to stay calm, I’ll keep making decisions I’ll regret.
